privacidad.title: Privacy policy for the Cuadrao website

blocks.text: Effective: October 15, 2026 Last updated: October 16, 2026
1. Who we are
This site is run by **Cuadrao LLC** · 1209 Mountain Road Pl NE Ste N, Albuquerque, NM 87110, USA · hola@cuadrao.ai
2. What we collect and why

items: **Cuadrao personal app waitlist:** your email (required) and, if you want, how you track your spending today and, in up to 280 characters, what you would like Cuadrao to solve for you. We use those answers only to understand what to build. Don't include account, card or health details, or other sensitive data; if we see them, we delete them. You only join the list once you confirm through the link we email you (it expires in 48 hours); if you don't confirm, we delete your email 7 days after you sign up. We will only write to you about the list and the app launch: the confirmation, one reminder if you don't confirm, a welcome email you can reply to, and the notice when the app is available. Every email has a link to leave the list.

**"Hablemos de tu negocio" form** (let's talk about your business; section "Empecemos por tu negocio", let's start with your business): your name; your email; your role ("Soy" / I am: business owner, accountant or other); what you struggle with; your preferred channel (email or WhatsApp); your WhatsApp number, if you give it; how you heard about us; and the optional checkbox "Quiero ver el prototipo y probarlo" (I want to see the prototype and try it). We use them to reply to your inquiry, contact you on your preferred channel, understand your business better, learn how you found us and, if you tick the box, invite you to try the prototype. The box is unticked by default, and you can untick it or ask us to stop inviting you at any time.

blocks.text: If you choose WhatsApp as your preferred channel and give us your number, you agree that Cuadrao may message you on WhatsApp only to reply to your inquiry. We will not send you announcements or launch notices on WhatsApp without separate permission, and you can ask us to stop messaging you at any time, for example by replying "BAJA".

items: **Basic technical data:** such as your IP address and browser details, logged when you visit the site or submit a form. We use them only for site security and to prevent spam and abuse. Our security service also processes technical signals, such as your IP address and browser and connection data, under its own privacy policy.

**Direct messages by email or WhatsApp:** if you write to hola@cuadrao.ai or on WhatsApp without using the form, we receive your name or number, your email and whatever you tell us. We use it only to reply and follow up.

blocks.text: On the form, your name and email are required so we can reply; everything else is optional and, if you leave it out, we still reply. Each form inquiry reaches us as an email in our inbox.
We ask for no more data than those purposes need.

**Cookies:** we use only the cookies needed for the site's security and operation, set by us or by our security service (for example, to check that you're not a robot). We don't use analytics or advertising cookies. If that changes, we'll ask for your permission first. We don't track your activity across other sites or over time, and we don't allow third parties to do so for advertising or analytics. Our security service may process technical signals under its own policy (see §4).

**Do Not Track and GPC signals:** because we don't track anyone across sites or use analytics or advertising, there is no tracking to turn off; we treat every visitor the same whether or not their browser sends these signals.
3. Legal basis and consent

We process your data with your consent, which you give when you join the Cuadrao personal app waitlist or submit a form after seeing the notice next to the button with a link to this policy (Dominican Law 172-13, art. 5.3 and 5.4). For the "Hablemos de tu negocio" form, we also use your data to answer the request you make before any possible agreement. You can withdraw consent at any time; that does not affect what we did before.
4. Who we share it with
We do not sell your data or share it for advertising. Only providers that help us run the site see it, and only for that purpose, except as noted for the security service:

items: our inbox provider, where we receive emails and form inquiries;
our database provider, where the Cuadrao personal app waitlist is stored;
our security service, which checks that you are not a robot. It also acts on its own behalf, under its own privacy policy, for example to improve its service.

blocks.text: If you choose WhatsApp as your preferred channel or write to us on WhatsApp, we receive your number and your messages, and the WhatsApp service processes them to deliver them, possibly outside the Dominican Republic, because that is necessary to answer your request.
We may also disclose it if the law or a competent authority requires it.
5. Transfer to the United States

Cuadrao LLC is in the United States and most of our providers store data there; our inbox provider, our domain and network provider, and the security service process data in the United States or in other countries. That transfer is needed to handle your request, and you accept it by signing up or submitting the form after seeing this notice (Law 172-13, art. 80.1 and 80.6).
6. How long we keep it

items: **Cuadrao personal app waitlist:** if you don't confirm, we delete your email and answers 7 days after you sign up. If you confirm, we keep them until you leave the list or 12 months after you sign up, whichever comes first; then we delete your email and your answers.

**"Hablemos de tu negocio" form:** we keep the email with your inquiry as long as needed to reply and follow up, and at most 12 months after our last contact; then we delete it. If you sign an agreement with us, that agreement governs that data.
**Direct messages (email or WhatsApp), or if you reply to one of our emails:** at most 12 months after our last contact; then we delete them.

blocks.text: We keep technical data (IP and browser details) for up to 30 days, only for security and spam and abuse prevention, then delete it. Our security service may keep the technical signals it processes under its own terms.
7. Your rights

You can ask to access, correct or delete your data, or object to its use. Email hola@cuadrao.ai. It is free. We give access within 5 business days and correct or delete within 10 business days. You may also go to a judge with a habeas data action.

To confirm it is you, we reply to the same email address you used to join the Cuadrao personal app waitlist or submit the form, or to the same WhatsApp number you wrote to us from. We do not ask for ID or other documents. If you write from a different email or number, we will ask you to write from the original one, so we don't hand your data to someone else. If the law requires us to keep any data, we block it and use it only to meet that obligation.
8. Deleting your data

Email hola@cuadrao.ai with the subject "Eliminar mis datos" (or "Delete my data"). To leave only the Cuadrao personal app waitlist, you can also use the link in any of our emails; we act within 10 business days. More details at /eliminar-datos.
9. US residents

This policy applies to everyone, wherever they are. We do not sell or "share" personal information as those terms are defined in the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). To use rights your state gives you, email hola@cuadrao.ai.
10. Security
We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your data, such as encrypted connections and limited access. No system is completely secure.
11. Children
This site is only for people 18 and older and is not directed to children. If we learn that someone under 18 sent us data, we delete it.
12. Changes

If we change this policy, we post the new version here with its date. If the change is to use your data for a new purpose, we tell you first and ask for your permission again; if you don't give it, we keep using your data only as this version says.
13. Language and contact
In case of any difference, the Spanish version prevails. Questions: hola@cuadrao.ai.

How to ask us to delete your data

Email hola@cuadrao.ai with the subject "Eliminar mis datos". Write from the same email address you used to join the Cuadrao personal app waitlist or submit the form, or write to us from the same WhatsApp number you used before. That is how we confirm it is you, without asking for ID or other documents.
What happens next

items: We confirm that we received your request.
We delete your data within 10 business days, free of charge. If you first want to see what we hold, we send it within 5 business days (Law 172-13, arts. 8 and 10).
If the law requires us to keep any data, we tell you what and why. We block it and use it only to meet that obligation.
